messages:
sarah.sales: Heads-up — FinCore wants an enterprise commit. Need POC capacity + answers for their security questionnaire. Can we align on throughput sizing + preheat plan? :wave:

mike-ps: Thanks. I'd like to run a traffic sim to validate 99th pct latency under 2s. They expect 10k reqs/min during peak bursts, avg 3k reqs/min. How many reserved GPUs for that? cc @dave-infra

dave-infra: Ballpark: with our LLM (32k context, quantized) on A10G-like nodes we can do ~250 rps per GPU for small chat gen (<=128 tokens) with batching. 10k rpm = ~167 rps -> ~1 GPU for steady? Wait compute: 167 rps / 250 rps ≈ 0.67 -> need 1 GPU steady, but account for headroom/burst -> recommend 3 reserved GPUs + burst pool. Will post simulation cmds.

ana-ml: Also need to know model and avg token output. If they use reranking or long output token lengths will change numbers. Ask FinCore to provide sample prompts and average completion tokens.

sarah.sales: FinCore said model=redwood/open-chat-medium, avg out=220 tokens, 8 token prompts. They have a 95% SLA target for <500ms p50 and <2s p99.

tina-ops: With 220 tokens average, per-request compute is higher. Using throughput calc: tokens/sec per GPU ~ 45k (estimated). So 240 tokens * 167 rps = 40k tokens/sec -> ~1 GPU nominal. But p99 under 2s needs extra headroom -> recommend 4 reserved GPUs + autoscale to 8 during bursts. Also prewarm window of 10–15 mins before expected spikes.

dave-infra: Here's a quick sim command (local load generator):
```
# run 10 minute steady + 2m burst
kg-run --target 167 --tokens 240 --duration 600 & kg-run --target 1000 --tokens 240 --start 540 --duration 120
```
Adjust to our `kg-run` config, results -> tail latency, GPU util.

mike-ps: Pricing Q: FinCore expects committed baseline pricing with monthly overage. Can we give model-level unit rates and a burst credit scheme? They want credits to cover 20% monthly spikes.

sarah.sales: They're asking also about security: KMS integration, VPC peering, audit logs retention 13 months, and ability to sign BAA. Anyone own legal/infra for this?

dave-infra: We support customer KMS and VPC peering in Private and Dedicated. Audit logs via Console with S3 export (retention configurable). For hosted we can offer enterprise export + SOC2 docs. Legal needs BA review.

tina-ops: For Dedicated, autoscaler config we propose:
```
{ "min_gpus":4, "max_gpus":8, "scale_policy":"cpu+latency", "prewarm_minutes":15 }
```
This gives steady reserve + autoscale burst. Also enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts to save tokens.

ana-ml: Note: caching and quantization profile can reduce cost by ~25% in this workload. We'll recommend q4_0 for the model if accuracy checks pass.

mike-ps: Action items: (1) run traffic sim and share p95/p99 numbers @dave-infra (2) provide model sample prompts @sarah.sales -> send stat sample (3) legal to confirm BAA + data residency @amy-legal (4) draft pricing: baseline reserved + burst credits @josh-finance

sarah.sales: I'll collect prompts & secure their traffic schedule. Thanks all — will loop in @amy-legal and @josh-finance. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Created POC workspace and capacity ticket: PO-38921 (assigned to dave-infra).
